blocks.text: Swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list. **Quick Switch** pressed once flips between Photo and Video.

rows: Normal recording; EIS, Pre-Rec and loop live here
Keeps one subject centred; horizontal only (use 9:16 for vertical)

blocks.text: In Photo mode swipe up to set the aspect ratio and **burst rate**. Off takes a single photo. Burst rates depend on the ratio.

items: In Video or SuperNight mode, tap the **upper-left corner**.
**Pre-Rec** keeps the seconds before you press record.
**Loop Recording** keeps overwriting the oldest footage, dashcam style.
Press **Quick Switch** while recording, or tap the icon in playback, to mark a highlight.

Locks the horizon through full 360° rolls

blocks.text: Set it from the **upper-right corner** in Video or SuperNight mode.

items: Image icon › **PRO** › Colors: Normal 8bit, Normal 10bit, HLG 10bit, D-Log M 10bit.
**D-Log M** gives the most grading room; turn on **Color Recovery** to preview normal colours.
Image Adjustment sets texture (sharpness) and noise reduction.
Record 4K, 2.7K or 1080p 16:9 at **100 fps or more**, at least 3 s long.
In playback, stop at the moment and tap the slow-motion icon. You get a 1080p clip up to 960 fps (4× interpolation).
Up to 6 per video. Not in the first 1.5 s or last 2 s.
For slow motion while shooting, use the **Slow Motion** mode (4× or 8×) instead.
Control menu › **Custom Modes**: save a setup (e.g. bike, snorkel, timelapse) and recall it in one tap.
Control menu › **Quick Switch**: choose which modes the button cycles through and turn on **Voice Prompt**, so it announces the mode when it's on a helmet.
Control menu › **Orientation Lock** stops the picture flipping when mounted.
Control menu › **Screen Lock** stops wet hands or a chest mount from changing settings.
Control menu › **Full Front Screen** shows the whole picture on the front screen for framing yourself when vlogging.
Control menu › **Brightness** to see the screen in bright sun.

blocks.text: Control menu › Settings › **Voice Control**. English commands: “Start Recording”, “Stop Recording”, “Take Photo”, “Shut Down”.

items: Up to two DJI wireless mics over Bluetooth (control menu › Settings › Wireless Microphone). The mic transmitter can also start recording.
**Built-in Mic Audio Backup** saves a separate .wav as a safety copy.
**Wind Noise Reduction** (in PRO audio) works on the built-in mic only.
20 m bare, 60 m in the case. Not waterproof with the lens hood.
Battery door closed with **no red marks**; covers tight; seals clean.
Touchscreens don't work fully submerged; use the buttons. Without the case the Shutter/Record button stops working below 10 m.
Rinse in tap water and air-dry. No hair dryer.

blocks.text: Control menu › Settings › **Depth & Altitude**: choose Diving or Hiking & Parachuting. Depth isn't shown in the waterproof case. DJI Mimo's dashboard can overlay depth, altitude, speed and route on your video, and import data from Apple Health, Garmin Connect or .fit files.

items: Control menu › Settings › **Timecode**: reset it, or sync to the system time.
A timecode sync box can plug into the USB-C port to match other cameras.
**Timecode Display** shows it on screen.
Sand in the mic holes or vents: rinse with fresh water while all covers are closed and sealed.
Clean the lens cover with water, a lens pen, a blower or a lens cloth. No alcohol or cleaning fluids.
Don't take the lens cover off often: dust gets inside it.
Keep the quick-release slots free of sand before clipping into a mount.
Swapping the lens cover? Only when the camera is dry, or the lens fogs.
Connect in DJI Mimo › Playback › download.
Or USB-C to USB-C cable straight to the phone (USB mode; control menu › Settings › USB Mode if it isn't detected).
